notes: Preliminary: 7 batches. A capability index from fewer than 25 batches carries wide sampling error and is not a demonstrated capability.
Cpk and Ppk differ by more than 0.25: batch-to-batch variation exceeds the within-process estimate, which points to a drifting or shifting process rather than random scatter.
outcome.citation: ICH Q6A (specifications); capability indices per ISO 22514-2 and the individuals/moving-range convention (Montgomery, Introduction to Statistical Quality Control)
